translation.name: Fúka Moodaanaki Kira Ufa Afaqínaasa Ufa

book.name: ROOMMA
book.title: ROOMMA Pauroofa Roomma maqannaA akaranimaqoo ufafa.

content: Mandoosanakiqari maqee Yisuna findifiranaki maridaqa.

Oo qini qikaqaafasaa Roomma maqannaa mariasa qinee Pauroosa maqee ufa qimannimirara innee amiqimasee irimaru ufana qimannianaura. Faiqí anaasee sandufa faqa Mooseena sandufa faqa faiqí anaasee kuqiqa mi sandufana sia irifaranoo. Kaqi maru kamuqoo misa mina irisee mina ameemaanai maridaqa.

Nimundara fasiqa anaaseera foora sanda ufa ameemaanai maridaqa. Mi anaaseena afaaqi kaqi marinanoo mi anaaseefa narí afaaqindiri sanda ufa ameemaanai maridanoo narí afaaqisaa atooqanoo mariannoo, afaaqi kuqu finanoo mina anaaqa fannoo kaqi fifau mariannoo sia sandufa ameemaanai mariannoo sia narí afaaqisaa atooaannoo.

Mi anaaseena afaaqi kaqi marinanoo quandaki moo fasiqa marainnanara qummuarimari anaasee fee qifaranoo. Mina afaaqi kuqufinanoo sandufasaaqaraafa doo idukinoo maridanoo, quandakinoo moo fasiqa marainnanara sia minara ummuarimari anaasee fee qifaranoo.

Doo innee qini qikaqaafasaa innee faqa Mooseena sandufa ameemaanai mariasa doo innisaimbaqa qifaaqa fannoo Yisuna saimbaqa kuqinau. Doo mi kuqiranakiqari mina Yisuna namufaqa findifiqa minaindikiqa Anutuna ainainiranaki andeeqasee anoona ainaina imarinakina mariaqeera mariafanoo.

Ooqai maasa qeeqa faiqí faiqi iriranamau manoo manaa iqa fimariafananoo Mooseena sandufa anireenoo maasa manda oosana afaurammeeqee mara uqeera kikiqa maseenoo quandakinoo mareeqeenoo kuqirana ameemaanai quqaqisanau. Minara Mooseena sandufa nimaarusira ufa fannoo maasa karafusara foora rumbaqimaqanau.

Doo maqee iriaqa, maasa Yisuna faqa kuqiara foora iqa maridaqa maasa karafusa rumbaqa marianasaaqari idukuaki maridaqa sia kafaa ooqeenaa mariranaki fuanaura. Maasa Mooseena sandufamau fuannana mifa maasa mandainaina mara uqeera quqaannoo minara mi mau sia fuanaura, fukamau Anutuna maraquna aatata fuanaura.
Sandufa fannoo paqurimma qimifaqa qeeqa mandainaina kaqi maraidaqa.

Minara maasa Mooseena sandufara mandainainafee qianauree. Oo sia miqinoo maridanoo. Mooseena sandufa innee moosa ainainara sia nimuqusianifee qidanoo sia miqinoo marinaqa qinee moosa ainainara qimuqusimarina mina aaqee unoo qunara sia irini mana mana kaimmunaiqini. Minara Mooseena sandufakinaafa doo kooroomandee mandainainara qimaqimifaqa qisauriqa.

Mooseena sandufa fannoo moosa ainainara sia nimuqusiaqee qinoo marifanoo qini manda irirafa irisee quandakinoo firaaqoo moosa ainainara amuqusidanoo. Minara sandufa sia maru kamuqoo mandoosanara oonumafi irirafa kuqinoo marufaqa mana mana imariafannana.

Mooseena sandufa sia maru aukuana sia faiqí anaasee narufaqa sia kuqiara foora imariqau kaqi maridaqara foora imariqau. Mooseena sandufa nimaarusira ufa kambiqafufaqa misa naundurai manda oosana uqeera niminoo narinau. Miqimandaifanoo Anutuna kaqi marira nimira ufa fannoo kuqirana kai niminoo.
Misa naunduraki mari mandainaina fannoo misa narirara rakisinoo marifanoo Anutuna sandufa aniraifanoo mina qumareenoo minannai misa naru quqeenoo.
Mooseena sandufa faqa Anutuna naamuaqira ufa faqa andeeqarafa naaquqarafa amiqirafa maridanoo.

Amiqira ainaina fannoo fee misa kuqa narinoo fee qianauree. Oo sia miqinoo maridanoo. Misa naundurakinaa mandainaina fannoo kai amiqira ainaina mara mareenoo minannai misa narinoo. Miqi mandainanoo misa naundurakinaa anoona mandainaina akooqoo kooroo ianifeera miqinoo. Doo mi mandainainafa Mooseena sandufa saaqari innooqeenoo firaanaikinoo maridanoo.
Maasa qiqa daunduraindaraa irirafa oonu rarisee ani rarisee idanoo.

Qinee Mooseena sandufara kuqaa innaarunaindaraa ainainee qidaqa. Qini daundurakinaa mandainaina fannoo ainainira fasiqara foora qini feefaurummeeqeenoo nararamandunna quqaqisaqaisa mina rumbara saikaki maridaqa.

Qinee mi saikanaki maridaqa qeeqa auqee marunna saikoosanara faqa sia iridaqa. Qinee amiqira oosanara didimarina marararee qidaqa sia maraidaqa. Qinee dapi manda oosana fidiaqaaira oosana kai maraidaqa.

Qini irirafa qikooqeemari mandoosanna maraidaqa Mooseena sandufa fannoo qiniara aaqee mariifoo qimasaifanoo qini irirafa faqa mina irirafa faqa moodaaqoo apinoo marifaqa. Oo Mooseena sandufara anoona mariifoo qidaqa.
Miqidaqa sia qeeqa maraqunafau mi manda oosanna maraidau. Mandainaina fannoo qini daundurai marifa mifa qini qifeeqaraifaqa mi manda ainainna maraidaqa.
Qeeqa daundurakinaafa amiqira oosanna maraannee qifaqa qini irirafa anuqidanoo sia amanaikidanoo. Mina iridaqa maaqi qidaqa qiqa faiqí faiqi qimuqusaki amiqiroosanna sia minaki marifanoo fee qidaqa.
Amiqiroosanna auqararee qimasaidaqa miqooqari quandakifaqa qikooqeemari mandoosanna kai auqaidaqa.
Qinee qini qikooqeemari mandainaina auqaananoo sia qeeqafau auqaidau qini daundurakinaa mandainaina fannoo mina auqaidanoo.
Qinee amiqira ainaina iraree qunanoo mandainaina kai qini doorinni aniraifaqa mina kaimma auqaidaqa. Mi sandafa kai qini daundurai irirana qimidanoo.
Qini qimuqusa ookina Anutuna sandufara asasidanoo qiqa qifaaqaki mari manda ainaina mifa kai qini raineeqeenoo narí rumbaranaki quqaidanoo.

Qiqa manda qifaaqa fannoo qiqa daundura mareeqeenoo kuqiranaki quqaidanoo. Oo qinee nanaree kaaqa mandainainaki maridee firaaqoo doori runidee. Qeeqa qifaaqa qimana namufaqa kuqiranaki fuananoo yafee aniree minakinaana qini qimana mareeqee kaqi naaru mariranaki quqaqisaannoo fee.

Oo dufi dufi Anutufa narí asauku mundirana Yisuna maasa karaambaiqannai qini mareeqeenoo naaru mariranaki quqaqisaannoo. Doo maqee qinee minara maaqi qidaqa. Qini marirafa maaqimminoo maridanoo qeeqa qimuqusa daundurakinaa irirafa Yisunannai kai Anutuna sandufamau fidaqa qeeqa faiqí faiqi manda nirana marirana mandainaina sandamau fidaqa.
